basis: E6/E7 RF-v3 PortScan recall 0.999334/0.998336; E13 RF-v3 DDoS-like 2/801 and 4/1612; E14 requires class-level—not accuracy-only—decision.
failure: Any mandatory failure is NOT_PROMOTION_ELIGIBLE; document rather than tune or alter thresholds post hoc.

final_scientific_success.comparators: RF-v2, RF-v3, RF-v4 evaluated on exact same final matrices.
final_scientific_success.integrity: Final session/hash/lineage seal remains intact until candidate is frozen; no flow/capture overlap.
final_scientific_success.replication: All validation gates reproduced on at least 3 independent sealed sessions per class; aggregate and per-session results shown.

mandatory_metrics: paired predictions against RF-v2 and RF-v3
promotion_eligibility: Only after all validation and final scientific gates pass, a separately authorized F10 decision may consider promotion. Passing accuracy alone, training success, or one session never suffices.

requirements: training metrics reported without final data
no threshold tuning or final-data access

validation_success.ddos_f1: >= RF-v3 + 0.10 absolute on new F DDoS validation flows
validation_success.ddos_recall: on new ground-truth F DDoS validation sessions, >= 0.20 and >= 0.10 absolute improvement over RF-v3
validation_success.false_positives: No >0.02 absolute increase in Normal->DDoS or Normal->PortScan rate versus RF-v3
validation_success.macro_f1: >= RF-v3 - 0.02, with no mandatory class gate waived
validation_success.normal_and_portscan_f1: each >= 0.98 of RF-v3 value on identical flows
validation_success.normal_recall: >= 0.98 and no more than 0.02 below RF-v3 on identical validation flows
validation_success.paired_transitions: Report RF-v3 PortScan->RF-v4 Normal, RF-v3 Normal->RF-v4 anomaly, RF-v2 DDoS->RF-v4 Normal, RF-v3 Normal->RF-v4 DDoS, RF-v3 DDoS->RF-v4 Normal
validation_success.portscan_recall: >= 0.995 and no more than 0.005 below RF-v3
